The Elite Forum for Investment Leaders Navigating What’s Next

In global investing, strategy is everything — and in today’s market, it’s being rewritten.

As institutional investors confront structurally higher rates, geopolitical uncertainty, and the rise of private markets, the challenge isn’t just finding yield — it’s building portfolios that are resilient, diversified, and future-ready. Add to that the surge in private credit, ESG as a performance driver, and AI transforming asset management, and the stakes have never been higher.

Investment London brings together the leaders who are making these shifts work — not in theory, but in practice. From capital allocation frameworks that integrate private equity and credit, to AI-driven analytics reshaping investment operations, to ESG strategies unlocking alpha, this is where the major allocators and managers gather to share how they’re turning complexity into opportunity.

Whether you're allocating capital, raising a fund, or providing the solutions that move markets, this where you gain the insight, network and conviction to lead.


Seventeen major UK pension funds have pledged to invest up to 10% of their portfolios into infrastructure, property and private equity by 2030—half of which will be ringfenced for UK assets.

LIVE Reuters Editorial Coverage 


Senior Reuters journalists will take to the main stage to lead incisive interviews, challenge industry leaders with data-driven questions, and provide the independent, agenda-setting perspective that defines Reuters.

 

Our editors will tackle the tough questions that matter, delivering newsworthy journalism in real time—all moderated under the Reuters Trust Principles that ensure the editorial independence and integrity you expect from us.

Macroeconomic Outlook & Institutional Strategies 


Navigate volatility with clarity. From inflation and geopolitics to capital reallocation and portfolio resilience, hear from private market leaders, CIOs, and sovereign wealth leaders on how institutional strategies are evolving in a world defined by disruption. Gain exclusive insights in “The Capital Reallocation Era – Where Will the Next $10 Trillion Go?” panel session, where top investors explore how global capital is shifting in response to macro risk, reshoring, and megatrends.

2026 Investment London attendees benefited from:

Meaningful

Connections 


Investment London is attended exclusively by senior decision-makers from leading institutional investors and private capital firms. We've carefully curated an environment that prioritizes meaningful, high-value LP-GP engagement. With limited vendor presence and a focus on strategic matchmaking, every conversation is relevant, insightful, and grounded in shared investment priorities. Expect candid dialogue, fresh perspectives, and relationships that extend well beyond the event.

Trusted

Insights


Our agenda is built in close collaboration with leading LPs, GPs, and private capital experts to ensure every session delivers substance over soundbites. You’ll hear from true decision-makers through candid case studies, closed-door roundtables, and dynamic panel discussions — offering clarity on what’s driving performance across private equity, private credit, venture, infrastructure, ESG, and institutional strategy.

Actionable

Benchmarks 


Benchmark your strategy against the most influential investors in the business. Hear directly from CIOs, managing directors, and asset owners, and gain practical insights from peers facing similar allocation challenges. Every session is designed to help you validate your approach, sharpen your edge, and apply proven strategies with confidence.

Access to

Reuters NEXT Europe 


Co-located with Reuters Events: Investment London, NEXT Europe is co-curated with Reuters’ award-winning newsroom to bring together 400 heads of state, CEOs, financiers, technologists and civil society to think differently and go big on the defining challenges facing business, society and the world at large.




All attendees will have access to both Reuters NEXT Europe and Investment London.
